stops.name: Blockheide
stops.detail: The Blockheide presents itself as a varied heath landscape in the northwestern Waldviertel with the close interweaving of meadows, small-scale fields and mixed forests typical for the rural Waldviertler cultural landscape. Huge granite blocks, partly original shaped such as pyramid or loaf of bread, partly pronounced as wobble stones, are scattered in the landscape.
